the perceived benefits of ART were the most important motivator of adherence and that the barriers to adherence were the most important barriers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the benefits of ART outweigh the barriers.
ART improves quality of life and adherence, but it also has challenges.
ART is a life-saving therapy that improves the quality of people’s lives, but it is not a magic bullet and adherence is a challenge that requires a multi-faceted approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ART has improved the quality of life for people living with HIV in Uganda.
adherence is a complex phenomenon, and that it is crucial to consider the social, cultural and economic contexts in which people live when designing interventions to enhance ART adherence.

adherence to antiretrovial therapy is not only a medical challenge, but also a social challenge that needs to be addressed by the community, the government, the health care providers, the patients and their families.
